instructionFiles.note: Only one project context type loads per session, first match wins in the listed order. SOUL.md loads separately from HERMES_HOME.

subagents.note: The delegate_task tool spawns child agents, singly or in parallel batches; delegation.provider and delegation.model route them, and auto inherits the parent.

guidance.text: Hermes loads one project context file per session, first match wins: .hermes.md, then AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. A .hermes.md hides AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
A hermes chat -q run has nobody to answer approval prompts, so by default it denies any command the approval check flags and the agent must find another path.
Hermes clamps a requested reasoning effort down to the strongest level the route accepts, never up; ultra always maps to the route's top level.
Passing --yolo or setting approvals.mode: off removes every command approval prompt; use it only in a disposable or isolated environment.
